title: Wire serve.Deps and start HTTP listener with all routes
description: Implement gophermind-server/server.go: build serve.Deps (SessionTurn, Approvals, ListModels, EndpointModels, Pipeline, Skills, Devices, Run, Stream), call serve.NewMux, start HTTP listener. Include rate limiting, HMAC verification, backend status endpoint. All routes from the contract table must be registered and functional.
acceptance_criteria: All HTTP routes from the contract are registered and respond correctly
POST /session/stream returns SSE events (token, assistant, tool_call, tool_result, usage, done)
Auth: valid token accepted, invalid token rejected with 401
Rate limiting: 429 returned when limit exceeded
